lemma update_cdt_is_original_cap[wp]:
  "\<lbrace>\<lambda>s. P (is_original_cap s)\<rbrace> update_cdt f \<lbrace>\<lambda>_ s. P (is_original_cap s)\<rbrace>"
  by (wpsimp simp: update_cdt_def)
rationale: update_cdt is defined as set_cdt applied to a modified cdt; it touches only the cdt field. The file proves update_cdt_cdt[wp] at line 136 for the cdt field; is_original_cap is the natural sibling frame to add.
strengthening_claim: Adds an explicit wp-registered frame for is_original_cap over update_cdt where none existed.
